name: Ferrero Rocher Premium Cake
description: Rich hazelnut chocolate sponge layered with creamy Nutella filling, crushed Ferrero Rocher chocolates, and crispy wafer flakes. A chocolate lover's absolute fantasy.

name: German Chocolate Gateau
description: Indulgent moist chocolate cake layered with a caramel-custard filling loaded with toasted coconuts and premium pecans.

name: Lotus Biscoff Speculoos Cake
description: Caramelized speculoos sponge layered with biscoff cookie butter, frosted with light white chocolate mousse, and topped with whole Lotus biscuits.

name: Classic Red Velvet Drip
description: Vibrant crimson red velvet layers with hints of organic cocoa, filled and frosted with our signature luxury cream cheese frosting.

name: New York Baked Cheesecake
description: Rich, dense, and incredibly smooth baked cream cheese on a crisp graham cracker crust. Note: Please place cheesecake orders at least 24 hours in advance.

name: Nutella Hazelnut Cake in a Jar
description: Layers of rich chocolate sponge, nutella fudge, and toasted hazelnut bits packed into an elegant glass jar.

name: Lotus Biscoff Fudge Brownie
description: Super fudgy chocolate brownie block marbled with thick cookie butter swirls and topped with crunchy Biscoff pieces.

name: Chocolate Berries Drip Cake
description: Belgian dark chocolate cake topped with a rich dark ganache drip, fresh strawberries, raspberries, blueberries, and edible gold dust.

name: Whole Wheat Chocolate Orange Cake
description: Healthy choice chocolate cake made of 100% whole wheat flour, unsweetened cocoa, orange zest, and cold-pressed oil. 100% eggless.

name: Jaggery Dry Fruit Tea Cake
description: Fragrant tea cake sweetened with natural organic jaggery (no refined sugar) and loaded with almonds, pistachios, and raisins.

name: Ragi Chocolate Loaf Cake
description: Guilt-free dark chocolate loaf made with finger millet (ragi) flour, sweetened with dates, and topped with dark chocolate chips.

name: Multigrain Carrot & Date Cake
description: Healthy multigrain sponge loaded with shredded organic carrots, sweet date puree, walnuts, and cinnamon.

name: Almond Coconut Flour Cake
description: Low-carb gluten-free healthy cake baked using pure almond meal and coconut flour, frosted with light dairy-free cream.

name: Baked Chocolate Cheesecake
description: Silky baked chocolate cream cheese on an Oreo biscuit crust, topped with dark chocolate curls. Place orders 24h in advance.

name: Lotus Biscoff Baked Cheesecake
description: Our signature New York style cheesecake swirled with creamy Lotus Biscoff spread and layered on a Biscoff cookie base.

name: Tiramisu Espresso Cheesecake
description: Baked espresso cheesecake topped with coffee-soaked ladyfingers and a generous dusting of rich cocoa and mascarpone whip.
